batches.title: MidJourney
batches.description:
Ultra-realistic natural portrait for the my character a young woman with dark green eyes, freckles on the face and short dark soft wavy hair flowing beautifully in the autumn wind. Her delicate face with expressive eyes and light natural makeup looks serene and thoughtful. The camera is close to her face, cinematic framing, she looks off to the side, not at the camera. She wears a muted tailored coat and simple elegant accessories, minimalistic and contemporary, no retro style. Golden autumn trees and scattered leaves blur in the background, soft natural sunlight adding warmth and texture. The mood feels alive, authentic, atmospheric, with subtle melancholy a candid autumn portrait, refined yet natural.
